messages.Tick the box; the test continues on its: Tick the box; the test continues on its own once it is ticked.
messages.Google reCAPTCHA could not be loaded. Ch: Google reCAPTCHA could not be loaded. Check the site key and the domain; if Google is unreachable, try the "recaptcha.net" option.

messages.Forms are not protected yet. Enter your: Forms are not protected yet. Enter your Google reCAPTCHA keys and test them.

messages.Protects login, registration, comments,: Protects login, registration, comments, checkout, donations and form submissions from bots with Google reCAPTCHA. Choose below which forms to protect.
messages.Protection is turned off by the recovery: Protection is turned off by the recovery constant.
messages.Remove the FLXRC_DISABLE line from wp-co: Remove the FLXRC_DISABLE line from wp-config.php to turn protection back on.
messages.Enter your keys and press \"Test\". No f: Enter your keys and press "Test". No form is checked until the test passes, so a wrong key can never lock you out of the login screen.
messages.Submissions were let through without a c: Submissions were let through without a check at that time.
Submissions were blocked at that time.
messages.Get your keys %s: choose the reCAPTCHA t: Get your keys %s: choose the reCAPTCHA type and add your domain. The site key and the secret key must belong to the same entry.
messages.Visitors are never asked anything; Googl: Visitors are never asked anything; Google returns a score from 0 to 1. Recommended.
messages.A checkbox appears on the form; suspicio: A checkbox appears on the form; suspicious visitors get an image challenge.
messages.Entered once, stored encrypted and never: Entered once, stored encrypted and never shown again.
messages.One of the keys comes from a wp-config.p: One of the keys comes from a wp-config.php constant (FLXRC_SITE_KEY / FLXRC_SECRET_KEY); the value in this panel is not used.
messages.Runs a real check with Google; if it pas: Runs a real check with Google; if it passes, the keys are saved and protection turns on.
messages.If a form has its own reCAPTCHA option t: If a form has its own reCAPTCHA option turned on in Flux Forms, turn it off; two checks on one page conflict.
messages.Submissions scoring below this are block: Submissions scoring below this are blocked. 0.5 suits most sites; lower it if real people get stuck.
messages.Use recaptcha.net on networks where goog: Use recaptcha.net on networks where google.com is blocked.
messages.Members are not checked on comments, che: Members are not checked on comments, checkout, donations and forms. Login and registration forms are always protected.
messages.Let submissions through if Google is unr: Let submissions through if Google is unreachable
messages.Recommended. When off, no protected form: Recommended. When off, no protected form can be sent during a Google outage (admin login included).
messages.The reCAPTCHA badge in the bottom corner: The reCAPTCHA badge in the bottom corner is hidden; the notice Google requires is added under protected forms.
messages.IP addresses that skip the check: IP addresses that skip the check
messages.One IP or range (CIDR) per line. For you: One IP or range (CIDR) per line. For your office, tests and monitoring services. Your current IP address: %s
messages.If you get locked out of the login scree: If you get locked out of the login screen, add define( 'FLXRC_DISABLE', true ); to wp-config.php; protection turns off completely.
messages.Saved. The keys changed, so protection s: Saved. The keys changed, so protection stays off until they are tested.
messages.The site key and the secret key are requ: The site key and the secret key are required.
messages.These are v2 (checkbox) keys. Choose v2,: These are v2 (checkbox) keys. Choose v2, or create v3 keys in the Google console.
messages.These are v3 keys. Choose v3, or create: These are v3 keys. Choose v3, or create v2 keys in the Google console.
messages.JavaScript must be enabled in your brows: JavaScript must be enabled in your browser to send this form.
messages.This form is protected by reCAPTCHA and: This form is protected by reCAPTCHA and the Google %1$s and %2$s apply.

messages.The security check could not load. Refre: The security check could not load. Refresh the page and try again.
messages.The security check failed. Refresh the p: The security check failed. Refresh the page and try again.
messages.The secret key is invalid. Copy the \"Se: The secret key is invalid. Copy the "Secret key" from the Google reCAPTCHA console.
messages.The site key and the secret key do not b: The site key and the secret key do not belong to the same entry, or the wrong reCAPTCHA type (v2/v3) is selected.
messages.wp-login.php and the Flux Speed custom l: wp-login.php and the Flux Speed custom login address (e.g. /fluxadmin)

messages.Flux Forms submissions (contact, applica: Flux Forms submissions (contact, applications, login/registration forms)
messages.Protection is turned off by the FLXRC_DI: Protection is turned off by the FLXRC_DISABLE constant in wp-config.php. Remove the line once the issue is fixed.
messages.Google reCAPTCHA keys are not set; forms: Google reCAPTCHA keys are not set; forms are not protected.
messages.The keys have not been tested; protectio: The keys have not been tested; protection stays off until the test passes.
messages.%1$s: %2$s. Test the keys again; if Goog: %1$s: %2$s. Test the keys again; if Google is unreachable, set Settings > Google host to recaptcha.net.
messages.Between 0.1 and 0.9. Submissions scoring: Between 0.1 and 0.9. Submissions scoring below this are blocked.
messages.Leave blank to keep the saved key. The v: Leave blank to keep the saved key. The value is never read back.
messages.It protects login, registration, passwor: It protects login, registration, password reset, comment, WooCommerce account and payment, Flux Donate donation form and Flux Forms submissions against spam and bot attacks with Google reCAPTCHA (v3 invisible or v2 tile). Which form will be maintained is switched on and off from the panel; Flux Speed ​​is compatible with custom login address.
